name: mount_fuji_context
title: Mount Fuji, Japan
note: The whole cone (3776 m) with its apron, the Hoei crater on the south-east flank and the Fuji Five Lakes to the north.
grid: local azimuthal equidistant (sphere R=6371008.8 m) centred on centre_lat/centre_lon; x east, y north; row 0 = north edge; pixel centre x = (col + 0.5 - cols/2) * pixel_size_m, y = (rows/2 - row - 0.5) * pixel_size_m

source.dataset: GSI Tiles DEM10B (10 m mesh digital elevation model, elevation PNG tiles)

source.attribution: Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI Tiles, DEM10B)

attribution: Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI Tiles, DEM10B)
encoding: 16-bit greyscale PNG: height_m = height_min_m + v / 65535 * (height_max_m - height_min_m)
